title: Negotiation & Deals
promise: Ask for more, and get it, without the sweaty palms.
summary: Most people lose money in the ninety seconds after they say a number. This is a working playbook for salary talks, freelance rates, contract terms, and everyday asks: how to set your walk-away, anchor high without sounding greedy, survive the silence, and trade instead of caving. Includes full scripts for the awkward middle, where they say no and you have to keep going.
